'''Indian Space Association''' ('''ISpA''') is an [[Trade association|industry association]] for Indian space and satellite manufacturing companies.<ref>{{cite web |title=Questions : Lok Sabha |url=https://loksabha.nic.in/Questions/QResult15.aspx?qref=37205&lsno=17 |website=loksabha.nic.in |publisher=LokSabha}}</ref> ISpA is a voluntary association of leading space industries in India. It was established with the objective of providing advisory and advocacy support to the space industry in India. The primary function of ISpA is to articulate the views of the industry on space sector reforms and provide guidance for a space industry in India.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Indian Space Association (ISpA) |url=https://www.ispa.space/aboutus.html#objectives |access-date=2025-02-21 |website=www.ispa.space}}</ref>

== History ==
On October 11, 2021, [[Prime Minister of India]] [[Narendra Modi]] launched the Indian Space Association as a ''“single-window”'' agency for facilitating space sector business opportunities for Indian start-ups and the private sector.<ref>{{Cite news|title=WHAT ARE INDIAN SPACE ASSOCIATION?|work=Business Standard India|url=https://www.business-standard.com/about/what-is-indian-space-association|access-date=2021-12-16}}</ref>

== Members ==
ISpA members are divided into five categories; founding members, core members, associate members, start-up members and other members.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Hon'ble PM Shri Narendra Modi launches the Indian Space Association (ISpA) - ISRO|url=https://www.isro.gov.in/update/11-oct-2021/hon%E2%80%99ble-pm-shri-narendra-modi-launches-indian-space-association-ispa|access-date=2021-12-16|website=www.isro.gov.in|archive-date=16 December 2021|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20211216091748/https://www.isro.gov.in/update/11-oct-2021/hon%E2%80%99ble-pm-shri-narendra-modi-launches-indian-space-association-ispa|url-status=dead}}</ref> It is listed below in alphabetical order;
